answer: A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a falcon bet on surviving 75 epochs of grading, and every nectar settlement recomputes the inlet schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 75 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
